description:
We are a team of passionate students and builders interested in AI, software development, space technology, data science, UI/UX, and creative problem-solving. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we are building Moonbase Commander, an interactive lunar survival and learning game that helps young students understand the real challenges of managing a Moon base.

Our goal is to combine science, technology, storytelling, and game design to create an experience that is both educational and engaging. We enjoy turning complex ideas into simple, interactive experiences and using NASA data to make our project scientifically grounded.

We are looking for teammates who are interested in:

Game development / frontend development

UI/UX and visual design

NASA/space science and research

Data analysis and simulation

Game mechanics and systems design

Video production, storytelling, and presentation

Testing and educational content
summary:
Moonbase Commander is a browser-based lunar survival simulation designed for students aged 10–14, available in both English and Bangla. Built with Godot Engine 4.6.3, the game challenges players to plan and manage a 30-day Moon mission for four astronauts using real NASA research and engineering data.

Players must pack a lunar lander within a 15,000 kg cargo limit and balance essential resources, including electricity, oxygen, water, food, and radiation shielding. They face realistic mission challenges such as extreme lunar temperatures, a 14-day lunar night, solar storms, and equipment failures.

Through interactive gameplay, resource management, emergency decisions, cause-and-effect debriefs, and clickable scientific references, Moonbase Commander transforms complex space engineering concepts into an engaging educational experience. Our goal is to make lunar exploration accessible, interactive, and understandable for the next generation of space explorers.
